system.description:
With but a glance you spread your own madness like a psychological virus, hurling your derangements wholesale into another mind.

Make eye contact with your target, spend one Willpower Trait and one or more Mental Traits, and defeat her in a Social Challenge. Your victim receives all of your derangements and Mental Flaws, lasting one night per Mental Trait you expended.
system.duration: One night per Mental Trait spent
